notes: ICI says waivers put in place in 2020/2021 were pared back as rates rose; 2023 and 2024 reports cite 2021 starting point.
ICI 2022 expense report: waivers decreased from $8.4bn in 2021 to $4.1bn in 2022; waiver share declined from 96% in February 2022 to 74% in December 2022; average expense ratio rose 2 bp to 0.13%.
ICI 2023 expense report: average expense ratio rose 9 bp to 0.22%; waivers down to $1.6bn; waiver share 65% by year-end 2023.
ICI 2024 expense report: average expense ratio remained 0.22%; waivers down to $1.5bn; waiver share 64% by year-end 2024.
